channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Deskrawl: Idle ARPG
item.description: Grind mobs, farm loot and capture enemies to serve you. Deskrawl is an epic idle ARPG that plays at the bottom of your desktop. Farm legendary items and build overpowered heroes while you work or chill.

item.title: DARK SOULS™ III
item.description: Dark Souls continues to push the boundaries with the latest, ambitious chapter in the critically-acclaimed and genre-defining series. Prepare yourself and Embrace The Darkness!

item.title: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum
item.description: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum! is a cozy skeleton restoration sim. Identify, collect, and piece together around 2,000 scattered dinosaur bones. Feel chaos turn into order, and with every skeleton you rebuild, the museum reveals another secret.

item.title: Dragon Shelter
item.description: Dragon Shelter is a farming sim set in a fantasy world. Become a hero who'll reignite the long-lost friendship between humans and dragons. Care for wondrous creatures, explore the magical world, and cook enchanted dishes together!

item.title: Etrian Odyssey II HD
item.description: Take off to the skies for High Lagaard, a mysterious castle beyond the clouds. Assemble a team of heroes, seek the mystery of the colossal Yggdrasil tree and uncover the truth of the city!

item.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved
item.description: Halo: Campaign Evolved is a faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved’s campaign, rebuilt from the ground up.

item.title: Lucid Cats
item.description: An online co-op horror extraction game. Fall asleep, loot a shared nightmare, and find the escape to keep your valuables.

item.title: Obscure II (Obscure: The Aftermath)
item.description: Two years ago, a group of young teenagers found themselves trapped inside their school. They suffered through the longest night of their lives, chased by abominable creatures created by their principal. Some of them survived that terrible night, while others perished.

item.title: Scapewatch: Idle MMO
item.description: 30 skills. Three combat styles. Clans, raids, hiscores, pets, capes. Set up your queue, close the tab, come back richer. Scapewatch is the idle MMO for people who actually like the grind.

item.title: Spellcaster University
item.description: Develop a prestigious university of mages. Build rooms, train your students, fight orcs, slay the bureaucrats, manage your budget... a director's life is not a quiet one.

item.title: The Magus Circle
item.description: Magic is Art. The Magus Circle is a vampire-survivors, rogue-lite game where you draw to cast spells! Meet other mages and unlock their abilities. Discover the secrets hidden inside the Circle. Draw the sigil, protect the circle, save the cosmos.

item.title: Wild West Pioneers
item.description: Wild West Pioneers is a city-builder adventure about leading settlers into the untamed frontier. Build and manage growing settlements, establish production chains, and explore the world. Follow a story of gold rush dreams, dangerous encounters, and the search for your family.

item.title: Explosive Odds - Supporter Pack
item.description: The Explosive Odds Supporter Pack provides a few extra costumes. If you like the game and you like us and you want to give us more money here's your chance! Comes with two Pig Bot hats and the test hat!
